items.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, saying it is the most capable US open-weight model, with 816B total…
items.text: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, saying it is the most capable US open-weight model, with 816B total and 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. Muse Spark Open is available today and brings leading agentic capabilities to your desktop for the first time on Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

items.text: We’ve committed to having evaluators assess our safety practices. We're in discussions with multiple organizations, and have now given employee-like access to a team from @METR_Evals. In this post, we describe how we work with third-party evaluators:
items.story: Anthropic says it is giving employee-like access to METR as part of its pledge to partner with evaluators for assessment of its models and safety practices

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.301 released
items.text: Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS so unattended retry mode (CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting · Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the claude-api skill, including setting up trace destinations with the ant CLI · Added the % motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y · Added rows to a mod's Input: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line

items.text: Meet NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Our new open model combines reasoning and tool use with text, image, document, and video understanding for long-running AI agents. 120B total parameters with 12B active 🧵
items.story: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter open model for enterprise agents, and says it outperforms frontier models on specialized benchmarks

items.title: A researcher says modern neural networks are far more interpretable than believed, with most neuron…
items.text: A researcher says modern neural networks are far more interpretable than believed, with most neurons understandable in models up to trillions of parameters. The cause of polysemanticity in early model organisms wasn't superposition, but several ordinary, mostly fixable issues.

items.title: New: Accenture has told employees it will only fund $29 per month of Claude use. Meaning that emplo…
items.text: New: Accenture has told employees it will only fund $29 per month of Claude use. Meaning that employees who often spend as much as $1,000 a month are now scrambling to find ways to keep access to the tool. A sign of the continuing crack down of AI
items.story: Memo: Accenture has told many employees, some of whom had been spending as much as $1,000 monthly, that it will now only spend $29 a month per person on Claude

items.title: Offering expanded Claude access across all three branches of government
items.text: We are removing barriers to government AI adoption by offering Claude for Enterprise and Claude for Government to all three branches of government, including federal civilian executive branch agencies, as well as legislative and judiciary branches of government, for $1.
